discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in afa519c6db and c13ab75fdf: the detached submodule keeps its remote configuration — the `remote.*` and `branch.*` keys travel with the module's own config. `remove_nested_git_files_keeps_the_submodule_remote_configuration` covers it.

Still open. `detach_repository()` copies the common `config` but not `$GIT_DIR/config.worktree`, so a submodule that keeps `user.email` only via `git config --worktree` is detached without it — not done in this round, so the thread stays open.

Fixed. `parse_core_worktree` now scans the whole file and keeps the last assignment — git's own precedence for a repeated scalar key — instead of returning on the first match. See `core_worktree_repeated_key_honors_last_occurrence` in `crates/pi-vcs/src/git/mod.rs`.

Fixed in 1805265f: `parse_core_worktree`'s escape decoding now applies uniformly regardless of whether the value is quoted, since git decodes `\\`/`\"`/`\n`/`\t`/`\b` escapes either way and a double quote just toggles whether whitespace/`#`/`;` are taken literally. Added `core_worktree_decodes_unquoted_escapes`, a regression test for exactly the unquoted-with-escaped-quote form you described (`worktree = ../../../sub\"quote`, git 2.43's output for a submodule checkout path containing a quote) alongside the existing quoted-value test.

Fixed in 1fd147fe1855. `parse_core_worktree` now skips a leading U+FEFF before scanning, as git does, so the first `[core]` header matches and `core.worktree` is read. Added `core_worktree_skips_a_leading_utf8_bom`; it returned `None` before the change.
